claims.text: Data Center revenue grew by more than 60% in fiscal 2026, outpacing every other market platform.
Total operating expenses rose by less than 50% in fiscal 2026 while gross profit climbed far faster.
FCF north of $90B in FY26.
The share count is under 25 billion, even after the ten-for-one split.
Gross margin widened sequentially in each of the last two quarters.
The effective tax rate was higher in fiscal 2025 than in fiscal 2024.
Deferred revenue is a rounding error, well under 1% of annual sales.
Prepaid supply and capacity agreements on the balance sheet were higher at fiscal year-end than a year earlier, which tells you how hard they are locking up supply.
Networking now brings in more than a tenth of total revenue.
Data Center compute revenue by itself is bigger than the whole company's fiscal 2024 sales.
Diluted EPS more than doubled from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025.
Stock-based comp is under 5% of revenue, so the adjusted numbers are not flattering by much.
Debt has barely moved, with long-term debt about the same at the end of fiscal 2025 as a year before.

Payables are growing faster than cost of revenue.

Net income more than tripled in fiscal 2024.
Current assets cover current liabilities more than four times over.
